title: APODICTIC: /start and the Firewall
alt: Flowchart. Typing /start leads to three questions: what do you have, what do you want, and anything that changes how we work. The answers route to one of two lanes: your workflow, which ends in an editorial letter or structural plan, or the Nonfiction Argument Engine, which ends in a Dialectical Clarity letter and a marked-up piece. Dashed arrows from both lanes to 'rewrite your prose' are marked never: the Firewall.

steps.caption: Every edit starts at /start. The first question: what do you have?
The second question's options depend on the first answer.
The third asks what changes how we work: a deadline, nonfiction, sensitive content, or editing for someone else.
Fiction, ideas and series land in your workflow, which ends in an editorial letter or a structural plan.
Argument-shaped work, chosen up front or flagged at question three, lands in the Nonfiction Argument Engine.
The Firewall: neither lane ever rewrites your prose.
